title: Payload: sealed-envelope/0.1 (rltp-delivery@0.85, target Trust Tasks framework 0.6.0)
description: Payload schema per Trust Tasks 6.3 ($id = Type URI, describes only the payload). The sealed envelope of Delivery Contract section 5, carried as the payload of a sealed-envelope/0.1 document by a carrier that carries Trust Task documents (section 4.6, RLTP-DEL-5030); the recipient's carrier hands it, in its JCS serialization, to the receive of section 6.2.
